lang.welcomeTitle: Daejeon, one detour at a time.
lang.welcomeSub: Routes, real menus and the Korean you need — no app install.
lang.pronRoman: Pronunciation is shown in romanized Korean (Revised Romanization). It is a reading guide, not pinyin.
lang.pronKana: Pronunciation is shown in katakana, which is only an approximation.
lang.lede: Hangul menus and Korean at the counter. Edulleo takes care of the route, the order and the reply.
lang.turnScreen: Turn the screen to the staff

course.cap: A *ready-made walking course* from Daejeon Station: map, walking time and opening hours for every stop.

order.cap: Just *tap what you want* on the real menu. The Korean order is written for you, with pronunciation and audio.

staff.cap: *Show your screen* to the staff. They answer with one tap, and you read the reply in your language.

practice.title: Speaking practice
practice.tapWord: Tap a word to hear it
practice.tapMic: Tap the mic and say it
practice.voiceNotice: This app does not save your voice or what was recognized. Speech may be processed by your browser’s speech service.

stt.noSpeech: No speech was recognized. Try again in a quieter spot, or simply show the screen to the staff.
stt.timeout: Time ran out before we heard anything. Try again, or show the screen to the staff.
stt.network: The speech service could not be reached. Check your connection, or show the screen to the staff.
stt.error: Speech recognition stopped because of an error. Try again, or show the screen to the staff.
stt.aborted: Recording was cancelled. Try again, or show the screen to the staff.
stt.denied: Without the microphone we can’t check your speaking. Show the screen to the staff instead.
stt.unsupported: This browser does not support speech recognition. Show the screen to the staff instead.
stt.empty: Nothing was recognized, so there is no score. Please try again.

result.matchNote: This shows how closely the recognized text matched the phrase. It is not a pronunciation grade.
result.closeMatch: The recognized text matched the phrase closely.
result.tip: “{word}” didn’t match well. Say it slowly, one syllable at a time.

reply.payNext: Pay at the counter, then tap Done.
